question.text: A charge $\mathrm{Q}_{1}$ exerts some force on a second charge $\mathrm{Q}_{2}$. If a 3 rd charge $\mathrm{Q}_{3}$ is brought near, then the force of $\mathrm{Q}_{1}$ exerted on $\mathrm{Q}_{2}-$

options.text: will increase if $\mathrm{Q}_{3}$ is of the same sign as $\mathrm{Q}_{1}$ and will decrease if $\mathrm{Q}_{3}$ is of opposite sign.
